# House of Shaily

> An event venue and creative studio for hire in Koramangala, Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. One open hall with a wooden floor, track-mounted adjustable lighting, blackout curtains, air conditioning and no fixed seating. Booked by the hour through a live online calendar: open 9am–11pm every day, 2 hours minimum, up to 12 hours in one booking.

Address: Chandru Chambers No.21, Basement 1, 7th Main, 1st Cross, 80 Feet Road, 1st Block Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India.
Contact: hello@houseofshaily.com · +91 91109 75470

Used for: theatre rehearsals and performances, stand-up comedy and open mics, dance classes and practice, acting / improv / storytelling / public-speaking workshops, photo and video shoots, meetups, community events and private gatherings.

Prices and capacity are not published; ask when requesting a slot.
